name: GET /api/admin/voice/capacity - Per-tenant voice load against plan caps
description: OPERATOR route (x-admin-ops-token). Platform-wide voice load for the console capacity dashboard (095f8479-500d-4e1e-8243-578b788fb8aa#AC2): one row per tenant that has an active AI call (dialing, ringing, in_progress, transferred) or a running/paused campaign, busiest first, with active_calls, by_status, test_calls, slots_in_use (the dialer's concurrency slots), plan_cap and alert_at (the tenant's voice.concurrent_calls quota policy; alert_at = its soft cap or 80 %), at_alert / at_cap flags, the slot backend (redis | postgres) and running/paused campaign counts; plus totals (tenants, active_calls, at_alert, at_cap). The same snapshot the dialer enforces when admitting calls. Missing/wrong ops token -> 401/403.
